title: Krea Region Prompt
description: A region-based prompt that recreates a reference photograph. The main subject must be the first and largest element, and descriptions must preserve visible facing and motion direction.

high_level_description.description: One sentence describing the whole image and the main subject's dynamic posture, including its left or right facing or motion direction when applicable.

aesthetics.description: Optional mood, composition, camera framing, and lens feel.

lighting.description: Optional description of the light in the scene.

palette.description: Optional dominant colors sampled from the image.

elements.description: Two to six useful regions in importance order, with the main subject first.

type.description: A normal object or subject region.

desc.description: A vivid, grounded description of the region. Describe actual limb and torso positions and repeat visible facing or motion direction when applicable.

x.description: Normalized x coordinate of the box's top-left corner.

y.description: Normalized y coordinate of the box's top-left corner.

w.description: Normalized box width. The box must also satisfy x + w <= 1.

h.description: Normalized box height. The box must also satisfy y + h <= 1.

palette.description: Optional dominant colors sampled from this region.

type.description: A region containing prominent lettering genuinely visible in the reference.

desc.description: A vivid, grounded description of the text region and its visual treatment.

text.description: The literal words visible in the reference; never invented text.

x.description: Normalized x coordinate of the box's top-left corner.

y.description: Normalized y coordinate of the box's top-left corner.

w.description: Normalized box width. The box must also satisfy x + w <= 1.

h.description: Normalized box height. The box must also satisfy y + h <= 1.

palette.description: Optional dominant colors sampled from this region.
